findings.behavioral_boundary: The test confirms no 20261011 relation bodies are joined into 20261009 matches/assessments. It does not preserve temporal isolation of the historical input identity: later evidence/review metadata is an input to the digest and persisted selected-source identity list.

evidence.fact: The daily archive whitelist admits current evidence file SHA, artifact SHA, and review receipt SHA as relation source identity fields.
All relation_source_artifacts from the current resolver are copied to the daily archive without filtering by target cutoff.
The historical input_identity digest includes relation_source_identities.
The resolver adds CURRENT_REVIEWED_RELATION_EVIDENCE identities from the 20261011 file and review receipt even when current relation/review rows are after the target cutoff.
The 20261009 test proves relation bodies are seed-only but explicitly asserts the later current evidence artifact SHA and review receipt SHA remain in relation_source_identities.

findings.required_repair: For a target cutoff before the current evidence/review became available, exclude those later evidence/review identities from the historical input_identity and selected relation_source_identities. If needed for audit, place current-registry observations in clearly isolated diagnostic metadata that is not a selected source and does not affect historical product identity.
findings.title: Historical 20261009 input identity includes post-cutoff 20261011 relation/review identity
